fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects potential DLL side loading of DLLs that are part of the Wazuh security platform
fields.name: Potential Wazuh Security Platform DLL Sideloading
fields.query: event.type="Module Load" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((module.path contains "\\libwazuhshared.dll" or module.path contains "\\libwinpthread-1.dll") and (not (module.path contains "C:\\Program Files\\" or module.path contains "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\")) and (not ((module.path contains "\\AppData\\Local\\" or module.path contains "\\ProgramData\\") and module.path contains "\\mingw64\\bin\\libwinpthread-1.dll"))))
